items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Roy Palmer? [INTERVIEWEE] Palmer or Honoré Dutrey. It wasn't Ory.

ctx.x: Yeah. He'd come up to San Francisco anyway. Ram was in that band, Tudie, Lil Armstrong, Baby and Johnny Dodds, I think, and King Oliver. I've got a picture of them. I can't think who was playing trombone?
Palmer or Honoré Dutrey. It wasn't Ory.
